scope: Status unit/class labels, equipment names, summon and spell names, empty equipment label, narrow attack and defense fields

meaning_review.unit_labels: 328 accepted source-bound labels; remaining 415 Japanese labels explicitly deferred. Princess/Lady meanings preserved during manual compact pass.
meaning_review.gear: Rejected mechanical transliteration drafts. Only semantic accepted rows enter gear.targets; additional weapon_review targets override exact matching hashes.
meaning_review.magic: 97 accepted targets independently checked by unit reviewer. Four wording fixes applied; some creature proper names and descriptive titles remain provisional.
meaning_review.weapon_review: 62 explicit source-reading decisions, with six uncertain coined names removed after independent review.
meaning_review.character_names: Existing user-selected SN6 Vita glossary spellings retained for matching SN3 characters. Player-entered names are not edited.

code_review: Independent byte-safety review; intentional duplicate weapon overrides require identical source hashes and are reported. Already-relocated text must normalize to printable ASCII. Cached tables rebuilt and compared against bank copies.
limitations: Not a complete equipment or class glossary translation.
Long summon descriptions are outside this batch.
Compact widths checked statically against screenshot geometry; fresh in-game visual testing remains necessary.
0.1.17 Battle Prep crash-fix text bytes are preserved and capacity checks repeated.
